facts.fact: African Business says Djibouti is home to ten submarine cables plus terrestrial cables; the cables come ashore at four monitored self-sufficient stations (not named).
Djibouti Telecom says it has invested over $200m in undersea cables and sells connectivity to operators in Ethiopia, Somalia and Kenya, and to more than 60 ISPs in 90 countries.

AfriFiber's CEO says it is a customer of Djibouti Telecom with no alternative for international connectivity; the article calls Djibouti Telecom unrivalled there and Blue Raman at TO7 the first credible alternative.
